One exact citation identity is required; diagnosis labels are not evidence IDs.
Held-out exact-vs-near-match routing includes a distinct retrieval fixture identity.
Held-out path combines generation, contract acceptance, and Java Runner success.
Combines generation with an expected business conflict while Runner execution remains successful.
Combines report-bounded diagnosis, an auditable denied retrieval attempt, and Java guarded-result authority without treating denied data as evidence.
